blurb:
Venture into the depths of Monterey Bay for an unforgettable small-group whale watching experience aboard Enocean's 27-foot Robalo. Departing from Moss Landing Harbor, this tour offers unobstructed views of whales and dolphins as you explore the nearby Monterey Submarine Canyon. Opt for the extended 5-hour tour to increase your chances of encountering blue and fin whales, especially during peak seasons. Enjoy personalized onboard photography advice, and receive a photo package afterward, ensuring you capture every moment of your wildlife adventure.

- Choose from 3-hour and 5-hour whale watching tours
- Maximum of 6 passengers ensures a personalized experience
- Opportunities to see a variety of marine wildlife including orcas and humpbacks
- Private charters available for intimate group outings
